scope: Credential-free review of the supplied export. No external Google Sheets requests or live n8n executions performed by this script.

checks.name: email-workflows / this-month produces Priority and an unsent draft
email-workflows / next-quarter produces Standard and an unsent draft
email-workflows / exploring produces Discovery and an unsent draft
form-to-sheets / this-month produces Priority and an unsent draft
form-to-sheets / next-quarter produces Standard and an unsent draft
form-to-sheets / exploring produces Discovery and an unsent draft
omitted and explicit-null budgets normalize to null and are explained as undecided
zero budget remains zero and budget does not change priority
invalid budget types and values are rejected
unsupported service and timeline are rejected
missing or non-boolean consent is rejected
normalization trims text, lowercases email, and discards extra fields
bad shapes, missing fields, invalid email, short message, and multiline contacts fail
Sheets appends the expected eleven fields and preserves zero in budget mapping
valid branch reaches Sheets before success response and invalid branch bypasses Sheets
response references handoff data and uses 200 / 422 status codes
sanitized copy removes account bindings, original sheet reference and instance metadata
